proposals.title: Give Each Share an Equal Vote
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a recapitalization plan, phased out within seven years, so all outstanding stock has one vote per share, eliminating Class B disproportionate voting rights.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends that stockholders vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Nomination of Human Rights and/or Civil Rights Expert to Board
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Nominating Committee to nominate at least one independent director candidate with recognized high human and/or civil rights expertise for the next Board election.
proposals.evidence: our Board of Directors recommends that stockholders vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Report on Sustainability Metrics
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a Compensation Committee report assessing integrating sustainability metrics, including senior executive diversity metrics, into executive pay performance measures or vesting conditions.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends that stockholders vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Report on Takedown Requests
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report assessing feasibility of annually disclosing by jurisdiction terms, queries or sites delisted or censored in response to government requests.
proposals.evidence: our Board of Directors recommends that stockholders vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Report on Whistleblower Policies and Practices
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a third-party review of the effectiveness of whistleblower policies in protecting human rights, with a public report.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends that stockholders vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Report on Charitable Contributions
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report listing and analyzing charitable contributions, including recipients, restrictions, outcomes and reputational risks from donation controversies.
proposals.evidence: our Board of Directors recommends that stockholders vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Report on Risks Related to Anticompetitive Practices
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on how the board oversees risks related to anticompetitive practices, including committee responsibility and board role in public policy.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends that stockholders vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Transition to a Public Benefit Corporation
proposals.topic_summary: Requests amending the charter to become a public benefit corporation, contingent on Class B holders converting shares so at least 60% of voting power is not Class B controlled.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends that stockholders vote "AGAINST" this proposal.
